name: The blind bandit never gives up
source:
Toph as the blind bandit in the ring get punishet for being a cocky girl in front of an audience.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ382954.html?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
拓芙以「盲眼大盜」的身分登上擂臺，卻因態度傲慢，在觀眾面前受到了懲罰。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ382954.html?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
